biggest_catch: Direct deposits must be real payroll/government ACH — Zelle, Venmo, wire transfers, and account-to-account transfers do not qualify, and the account must still be open with a balance above zero ~4-5 months later when the bonus is processed.
catches: Must be new to Old National personal checking: no existing ONB personal checking, no owner/signer status on a joint account, no personal checking closed within the last 36 months, no ONB checking promotional bonus in the last 36 months, and not an ONB employee.
Open an ONB Everyday Checking or ONB Preferred Checking account with a minimum $50 deposit between February 3, 2026 and October 30, 2026.
$300 tier: 3 or more qualifying ACH direct deposits totaling at least $3,500 within the first four months of account opening.
$600 tier: 3 or more qualifying ACH direct deposits totaling at least $12,000 within the first four months of account opening.

Qualifying direct deposits are recurring electronic deposits from an employer or government agency (paycheck, pension, Social Security, other government benefits). Excluded: teller/ATM/mobile deposits, micro-deposits, internal and external transfers, wire transfers, debit card transfers, and peer-to-peer services such as Zelle or Venmo.
Account must be open with a balance greater than zero at the time of bonus processing; closed, restricted, or zero/negative-balance accounts receive no bonus.
Bonus is deposited between 121 and 140 days from when the account was opened.
Online account opening is available only to applicants residing in IA, IL, IN, KY, MI, MN, ND, TN, or WI; others may apply at a banking center.

Everyday Checking has a $6.95 monthly service charge, waived with $500/month in direct deposits, a $500 daily balance, $1,500 combined daily balances, 15+ posted debit transactions per cycle, or active-duty military status; eStatements are free but paper statements cost $3.
The fetched official offer page does not state how the bonus is reported for tax purposes; expect it may be reported to the IRS as taxable income (not confirmed in the official terms shown).
